_other_faction_share: Selling on Blackwater: list at this share of the other faction's price, so their traders can still resell at a profit (or match a cheaper Blackwater listing).

deposit.note: Auction deposit for a 24 h listing as a share of the vendor sell price (Classic rule, used by WoW: Forever: 5%/20%/60% for 2/8/24 h on faction houses, five times that on Blackwater), at least min_listing copper per listing (1s; Blizzard plans to cut it to 1c: then set 1), shared by a stack of `stack` for stackable goods. Lost if the item does not sell.
